text:
The presence behind my left shoulder stayed for months. Not all the time, but often, especially in the evenings. I'd keep turning around. I couldn't sit with my back to a door. I also couldn't look into mirrors for long, because I was afraid of falling into my eyes again.

I had a strong fear that I'd broken my brain, and every unusual thought made me panic. I'd ask my flatmates if I seemed normal. I had panic attacks several times a week in the first three months.

My old depression came back, worse than in my teens. I stopped going to work and lost my job. I moved back in with my parents, which made me feel like a failure. I had thoughts that I'd been right during the trip, that my life was over. I spent most days in bed.

The voice saying 'it's over now' came back sometimes when I was falling asleep, and I'd jolt awake.

I also had derealisation for months, the world looked like a dream, especially in bright light.

I lost contact with K, which was sad, because we'd been close. Neither of us knew how to talk about it.

Ich hatte danach lange Zeit Albträume über den Onkel und habe ihn auf Familienfeiern nicht mehr ertragen. Ich hatte starke Schuldgefühle gegenüber meiner Schwester und habe mich selbst verachtet, weil ich nichts gemerkt habe. Ich war wütend auf alles und habe mich von meinen Eltern zurückgezogen. Gleichzeitig hat sich unsere Beziehung als Geschwister vertieft.
Couldn't stand masks or costumes for a long time. Panic at Halloween every year since.
Ich kann seitdem keine Horrorfilme mehr sehen. Ein paar Wochen lang hatte ich Angst vor Spiegeln im Dunkeln.
Anxiety at night for a few months, especially with unfamiliar noises. We laugh about it a bit now, but my wife says it was scary to see me like that.

For about a year I had a fear of enclosed spaces that I'd never had before. Lifts, small rooms, even tight clothing made me panic. At night I'd wake up feeling the weight of the earth on my chest. I had to sleep with the window open, even in winter. I became preoccupied with death and kept thinking about my children growing up without me. I was more anxious and irritable than before, and my wife noticed I was withdrawing. I also had broken nails that took weeks to grow back, and every time I looked at them I remembered.
Ein paar Wochen Unruhe, dann gut. Musik höre ich seitdem anders, bewusster.

I developed a strong fear of hospitals and doctors, and of any loss of control over my body. I also had health anxiety, especially about my heart and seizures. For about a year I was afraid to sleep because I thought I might have a seizure in my sleep. My memory was patchy for a few months, and I had trouble concentrating at university. I felt ashamed about how I'd behaved in the hospital. I don't drink or take anything now, not even painkillers if I can avoid it.

Ich habe danach eine Zeit lang starke Gesundheitsängste gehabt und bei jedem Kopfschmerz an einen Tumor gedacht. Im Studium konnte ich manche Vorlesungen, z.B. über Neuroonkologie, kaum ertragen. Ich habe mich von meinem Hausarzt durchchecken lassen, alles war in Ordnung, was die Angst nur kurzfristig beruhigt hat.
Didn't go to forest parties again. A few nightmares about dark corridors. Otherwise okay.

For several months I had a sense that I might really be in hell and that normal life was the illusion. It made me depressed and anxious. I'd stare at the flames on the stove and feel a jolt of panic. I also became very preoccupied with religion and sin, which I never was before, and spent hours reading about the afterlife at night.

Ich habe mich danach lange in der Wohnung meines Freundes unwohl gefühlt und hatte Angst, wenn es geklingelt hat. Unsere Beziehung hat darunter gelitten, und wir haben uns ein paar Monate später getrennt.
